statement: Intel's first data-center GPU 'Crescent Island' (Xe3P, 160GB LPDDR5X) is guided to customer sampling in the second half of 2026.
why: A new merchant data-center GPU entrant adds alternative accelerator supply beyond NVIDIA and AMD.

impact.mechanism: Intel entering DC GPU sampling expands alternative merchant-GPU supply over time.

evidence.excerpt: 'Crescent Island,' targets 160GB LPDDR5X memory and is guided to customer sampling in the second half of 2026
